reviews.text:
After searching online, this was the only cattery that suited me because of its personalized approach and, most importantly, because my cat wasn't crammed in with others. So I booked for two weeks, and what a great choice it was! It truly is a cat hotel, not a typical boarding facility!
The flexible hours allow me to drop off and pick up my cat whenever I want, and from the moment she arrives, you can feel the love for our little cats 🥰 I received a video of her every day to reassure me (yes, I missed her a lot 😅). The environment is perfectly designed for our feline friends, with places to sleep up high, climb, hide—there's something for everyone!
In short, if you need to leave your cat for a few days for a weekend or vacation, head straight to this upscale cat hotel; they're fantastic! (And the prices are very reasonable.) Thank you again for taking such good care of Sia these past two weeks 🥰

A huge thank you to Jeremie for taking such good care of my little ones.

It was the first time I'd left them for so long, so I was a bit stressed.

As the days went by, with the daily videos, I could see how pampered they were, which reassured me.

So I'll leave them with him without any hesitation next time.

Furthermore, Jeremie was very accommodating when my flight was delayed; he kept them for an extra night, so thank you again!

Our cat Alpha stayed for 15 days at the GentleCat Grand Hotel. It was the first time he'd been away from us, and we were a little worried.

We had two in-person meetings beforehand to guide us through the process.
Our cat had an excellent stay; everything was personalized around him in a caring environment.
We received daily updates with videos, which brightened our vacation and reassured us (we must admit we were eagerly awaiting this information).
We picked up our cat in great shape and we'll gladly return.
A special thank you to Jérémie 🐾

A superb cat hotel!
Apache had a fantastic stay with Jérémie, who sent us videos every day. You can trust him completely!
Apache will definitely be back for another stay!
Thanks again, Jérémie!

A perfect stay for our two cats, well-fed and comfortable. A great place in Lyon for anyone anxious about leaving their cat alone during the holidays.
The team is attentive to your cat's needs, and they make all sorts of adjustments on the spot if necessary! Fantastic hotel.

I left my cat there for 15 days; the stay went very well! I received regular updates and some helpful advice, as my cat loved the food and being brushed. I highly recommend it and will definitely put my cat back in this hotel whenever I need to.

I entrusted my cat to Jérémie for a week. He was attentive to his needs and took excellent care of him. The premises are great and, most importantly, air-conditioned! Thank you so much 🙏🏼

I highly recommend him!

First experience for my two cats, Maïko and Arya.

Maïko is ill and needs daily medication. The medication was administered professionally.

Several photos, videos, and messages were sent during their stay, which was very reassuring.

A big thank you to Jérémie and Jimmy for their warm welcome and for taking such good care of them.

We will definitely be back!

I highly recommend this hotel and thank you so much for taking such good care of Smooky 🫶🏻
I wouldn't hesitate to bring him back if needed …

Everything went very well for our two cats. The hotel's organization is perfect, and Jérémie is lovely, taking excellent care of the guests. A nice bonus: the rooms are air-conditioned. The GentleCat Hotel is truly a great option for leaving your cats in a safe and secure environment.
We entrusted our cat to Jérémie for a 3-day weekend. A very pleasant and clean place where cats are treated like royalty in spacious rooms 🙂 …

Incredible experience!
A short stay, but the first time away from home on their own for my little ones. Jérémie went above and beyond to welcome them properly and reassure them in record time (they didn't want to leave 🥲). Everything is thought out and planned for each guest, with a little something extra for everyone. The daily newspapers are a real treat (you'll soon see that when the mouse's away, the cat's still playing! 🤣).
The rooms are beautifully designed; every nook and cranny is useful.
Thank you so much, I will gladly return to leave Maze and Balthazar with you when the opportunity arises!

Thank you for taking such good care of Tiploof.
I was reassured every day by a short video and a message explaining what she'd been up to. I got her back in perfect condition.
I wouldn't hesitate to entrust her to you again!
Thank you

An exceptional hotel for our feline friends that I recommend 1000%!
My cat stayed there for a few days, and the team was incredibly attentive. They are very concerned about the cats' well-being and adapt to each cat's individual needs and personality.
What a joy to be able to leave with complete peace of mind, knowing your pet is in the hands of true animal lovers.
I wish them every success; they truly deserve it!
You can leave your companion there without hesitation!
A huge thank you and congratulations; you do things with heart, and it really shows ❤️

I was a little worried about leaving my little one with someone, as it was the first time we'd ever left him with anyone else, but my worries quickly vanished! The check-in process was already very relaxing; we were given a tour of the premises with our cat, which was lovely. We had opted for the video service, which allowed us to get a short clip of our cat every day with little updates, which was incredibly reassuring! The facilities are beautiful, the temperature is extremely comfortable, especially during this heatwave, and the managers are really kind and accommodating. Our little one is bursting with energy for his trip home! If we need someone to look after our little one again, we'll definitely use them here! Thank you again for taking such good care of Zeytin! 🌟

I'm so grateful to the GentleCat Hotel for their support with my cat Kuro! They were fantastic, and I know this little feline will definitely be back!

I highly recommend leaving your cat there; you'll have complete peace of mind knowing your cat is safe and sound!

Absolutely perfect. Jérémie was very accommodating with our late arrival. Our cat Charlie had a wonderful stay and loved the place and the toys. Jérémie kept us regularly updated on his stay. The rooms are clean. I highly recommend it!

I entrusted my two cats, Mambo and Naïa, to them for a short week-long stay and I have absolutely no regrets! Jérémie and Jimmy took wonderful care of my furry friends. The Gentlecat Hotel truly deserves its reputation as a 5-star hotel for cats; you couldn't find a better place to get away with complete peace of mind!

Thank you so much 🙏

We left our cat at GentleCat for 6 days; it was our first time, but we'll definitely be back! The place is great, the hotel is perfectly designed for our feline companions, and you can really see that Jérémie and Jimmy love cats and take very good care of them. A big thank you! :)

A huge thank you to Jérémie & Jimmy for this magical interlude for my two cats!

For both me and my cats, it was a first experience, and we weren't disappointed at all!! Jérémie and Jimmy took excellent care of Ernest and Josephine, adapting to my cats' specific needs (chronic conditions requiring a special diet). All instructions regarding feeding habits and medical treatments were perfectly followed!
They understood each cat's personality and gave us daily updates, which was wonderful!
My cats stayed in the ultra-comfortable "Presidential Suite" for two cats.

The hotel is stunning; everything is designed with cats in mind, the materials are of high-end quality, and the setting, ambiance, and decor are all top-notch! And above all, the hygiene is impeccable.

We were therefore able to go on vacation with complete peace of mind, delighted to find them back in top form and clearly enjoying themselves! Thank you so much, and we look forward to planning our next trip and our loved ones' next stay.
See you soon…
Hale.C

Gentle Cat Hotel, located in Lyon's Presqu'île district: a truly special place.

Jérémie welcomes guests with exceptional care and a genuine love for cats; it's immediately apparent.

The hotel is peaceful, tastefully decorated, and designed with their well-being in mind.

Regular photos and videos are taken throughout your stay, always perfectly captured.

You can leave your cat there with complete confidence.

I was a little nervous about leaving my cats at first, but in the end, everything went very well and we're delighted.

The hotel owners are truly lovely, and you can immediately tell they love cats. Our cats were very comfortable with them, which quickly put us at ease.

We received updates twice a day, which was very reassuring. At one point, we even wondered if they would want to come home, they seemed so happy there!

I would entrust my cats to them again without hesitation. 😸/10

Syrax and Brooke stayed at this cat hotel in Lyon, and I was very satisfied with the service. The staff is very attentive and provides regular updates, which is really reassuring.

They take good care of the cats. They even took my cat to the vet because he was scratching his ear, which I greatly appreciated.

I highly recommend this place!

Our little Perle's first stay at GentleCat was wonderful, and we were delighted with the experience. Perle made lots of friends and was treated with the utmost care. We wouldn't hesitate to entrust her to Jérémie and Jimmy again. A huge thank you!

I highly recommend this hotel for your cat.

I left my cat there for two weeks and I've never felt so reassured! Photos and videos every day.

The team at Gentle Cat are passionate people, and it shows in the care they give our cats.

Nugget will be back! Thank you to the whole team.

I'm so happy and grateful to have discovered GentleCat.

I left my Kyma there, and she settled in very quickly. Everything was perfect, from her arrival to her departure.

It's so reassuring to know your pet is safe and secure while you're away.
Thanks again, Jérémie!

See you soon ;)

A truly successful first experience! The atmosphere is both pleasant and calming, and what a joy to see these little felines roaming freely among the customers. A Lyon spot that all cat lovers absolutely must discover!

I highly recommend the GentleCat Grand Hotel! I left my cat there recovering from a paw injury, and Jérémie and Jimmy took excellent care of him. You can feel the genuine love for cats from both owners.

The hotel is very clean and quiet, and the rooms are spacious and comfortable. My cat was pampered even more than at home.
Excellent pet-sitting experience. I had Jeremy look after my cat for a week, and he took wonderful care of him. I highly recommend him.
Excellent experience. Jeremy took care of Praline like a princess. I highly recommend it.

First experience for my two cats, one of whom is ill and needs daily medication. The medication was administered each day with care and professionalism.

The rooms are truly spacious, comfortable, and worthy of a luxury hotel for our four-legged companions. You can tell that everything is designed for their well-being. They are pampered, with daily outings and plenty of playtime!

I received several videos and updates every day, which is extremely reassuring when you're away from them. The communication is truly excellent!

Upon my return, I found my cats in great shape, relaxed, and they immediately settled back into their routines at home—proof that they had a wonderful stay.

A huge thank you to the manager and the entire team for their kindness and professionalism. I will definitely use their services again! 🐾

A fantastic experience! I left my cat Zouzou with Jérémie for a week and was immediately reassured by his love for cats. I received daily videos and updates, and all instructions were followed perfectly, including feeding. You can tell he truly cares for cats. I recommend him 100% and would use his services again without hesitation!

This was my first experience with the cattery for my two cats, and I was already confident because I've known the cattery for over nine years. I had no doubt about Jimmy and Jérémie's dedication and professionalism!
The fact that the stays are completely customizable is a real plus, especially when cats need a specific diet or medication, as was the case for mine.
They were incredibly pampered, and Jérémie truly made it his mission to get to know them and make them feel as comfortable as possible, whether by talking with me or simply being there with them.
The calm environment is perfect for cats who are a little shy at first, allowing them to do everything at their own pace. I was incredibly surprised to see my little one, whom I thought was the least confident, going out without fear with Jérémie! The experience was truly wonderful, and very reassuring for owners who are a little anxious or not used to being separated from their cats. I was reassured throughout by the little updates and Jérémie's dedication!

In conclusion, thank you so much, and you'll definitely see the two little ones again the next time we have to be away!

An absolutely perfect stay for my cat at the Gentlecat Grand Hotel in Lyon. The establishment truly lives up to its promises: everything is clean, calm, well-organized, and you can really feel that the animals' well-being is their top priority. The staff were remarkably attentive, always gentle, available, and reassuring. My cat was truly treated like a little prince (and didn't seem to want to leave!). I absolutely recommend this place without hesitation; it's nothing like a cattery: it's a paradise for cats, a haven of luxury and indulgence.

However, be sure to book well in advance to have a chance of securing a spot...

It's a pleasure to interact with Jérémie at the Gentle Cat Grand Hotel.

He's responsive, attentive, and always pleasant, which makes communication very easy and reassuring.

You can tell he takes his work seriously and with kindness.

Anyone familiar with Gentle Cats knows how much the owners love cats and have cared for them for years. Going away for a weekend and entrusting your furry friends to this cozy and welcoming place allows you to truly relax. So don't hesitate!

Jimmy and Jérémie, the managers of the Grand Hotel GentleCat, have already proven their love and deep respect for cats and their well-being thanks to their 10 years of experience and success at the Gentle Cat (51 rue Auguste Comte, not far from the Grand Hotel GentleCat).

Tastefully and originally decorated (including many "homemade" touches like moldings and paintwork), the Grand Hotel GentleCat is both beautiful and designed for the comfort of its resident cats. Several cats (including some of the Gentle Cat's own females: Charline, Jeanne, and Diane) tested and approved the height of the shelves and furniture, as well as the comfort of the rooms and suites, alone or in pairs, before the hotel opened. Cats can roam, play, interact with other cats if their owners wish, climb, jump, hide, and be cuddled and pampered...

Jimmy and Jérémie have lovingly and humorously created a variety of cat boarding options: see their website for details. Cats can enjoy relaxation, gourmet meals, a complimentary tray... in short, cat parents are spoiled for choice.

Personally, I'd head straight to GHG Cat at 3 Place Gailleton!

An experience that exceeded my expectations! Thank you for the excellent service and for taking such good care of my beloved little one. I will definitely repeat the experience! Plus, the decor is amazing!! A caring team that truly prioritizes happiness and well-being. Thank you again for everything!
Thank you Rachel for your stay at the Grand Hotel GentleCat. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back again. 💛 …

A truly wonderful cat hotel where Marvel, our cat, stayed: I know the love and attention the Gentle Cat team gives our furry friends!

Go without hesitation, I highly recommend it!!

FYI, Marvel came back calmer and more sociable than when he arrived! 😇

A truly grand hotel for our feline friends, where the atmosphere is calm and welcoming. Like the GentleCat cat café, this hotel also reflects its owners: tastefully and meticulously designed to welcome our cat friends for a few days. Bravo for this unique project! 😻👏 …
Congratulations, this place is magnificent! Thank you for thinking of our four-legged friends 😻 …
Amazing place!!! I highly recommend it!!! What a great idea 😺😸😽 …
A very cozy place and royal service to make cats feel right at home.
A very cat-friendly and peaceful place!
A beautiful and inspiring place. The owners have a deep respect for animals.

A superb experience. I entrusted my 5-month-old kitten for 4 days to a team that took excellent care of him. The stay went very well, with updates or photos every day. I highly recommend them. Thank you, GentleCat.

A real gem! 🤩
The staff are incredibly welcoming and passionate. The concept is brilliant, it makes you want to be a cat... 😽 …
A magnificent place to celebrate cats! The staff were very welcoming and helpful. The decor was exquisite, with great class and taste. I was delighted with my experience.
Thank you Helena for your visit to the Grand Hotel GentleCat. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon. 💛 …
Thank you Madeleine for your visit to GHG. We hope to see you again very soon. 💛 …

Thank you so much, Emmanuelle, for your feedback.

Thank you also to you and your cat for participating in the Grand Hotel GentleCat trial periods.
We're delighted you enjoyed the experience and remain at your disposal for your next feline getaway 💛
Superb concept!
I've already reserved one for my cat, it's so pretty 😍 …

Having gone away for a few days and no one I trusted to look after my little Birman cat, I entrusted her to the team at the grand hotel without hesitation. Thank you to Astrid for her warm welcome in this welcoming place, perfectly suited to our feline friends.
The staff are incredibly attentive to the cats. The decor and comfort for the felines are top-notch. We can't wait for the opening!
An innovative, beautiful and welcoming place for our feline friends! Congratulations on this wonderful project!

Dear Audrey,
Thank you so much for your 5-star review 🐾
Your support means a lot to us.

We would be delighted to welcome you back to the Grand Hotel GentleCat 💛
An incredible experience in a haven of serenity. The cats are adorable, and so are the hosts!
The place is immaculate and well-maintained, just like our little companions. Thank you for creating such a beautiful space for them! We can leave them in your care with complete confidence!

🐱 An iconic place with charming owners. Very satisfied with the service!
Recommended by my friend Nikky, even in the northeast of France 🌟 …

Dear Maurice,
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating.

We are delighted that your visit left you with such a wonderful impression.
We look forward to welcoming you back to the Grand Hotel GentleCat 💛

Dear Laura,
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating.

We are delighted that you enjoyed your stay with us so much.
We look forward to welcoming you back to the Grand Hotel GentleCat 💛
Really great!

Dear Carole,
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating.

We are delighted that your visit left you with such a positive impression.
We look forward to welcoming you back to the Grand Hotel GentleCat 💛
Thank you for this superb hotel. My cat found it comfortable and welcoming. He will gladly return.
A magnificent, welcoming, and tastefully decorated hotel run by responsible owners.

We had the privilege of visiting this place.
Everything is perfect: the decor, the comfortable rooms, and of course, the cat rooms, etc.
We thank Jérémie and Jimmy from Gentlecat for putting their heart and soul into making this project a success.
We've already booked a date for our cat; he'll feel right at home there! 😺😺💚💚
A unique place where cats are treated like royalty! Every detail is designed for their well-being. Here, our furry friends are pampered and completely safe. Thank you!
